ck_confirmation_subject.name: ck_confirmation_subject
ck_confirmation_subject.value: ("confirmation"."scope" = 'once' and (("confirmation"."run_id" is not null)+("confirmation"."mission_id" is not null)+("confirmation"."workspace_id" is not null)) = 1) or ("confirmation"."scope" = 'run' and "confirmation"."run_id" is not null and "confirmation"."mission_id" is null and "confirmation"."workspace_id" is null) or ("confirmation"."scope" = 'mission' and "confirmation"."mission_id" is not null and "confirmation"."run_id" is null and "confirmation"."workspace_id" is null)

ck_permission_subject.name: ck_permission_subject
ck_permission_subject.value: (("permission_grant"."scope" in ('once','run')) and "permission_grant"."run_id" is not null and "permission_grant"."mission_id" is null) or ("permission_grant"."scope" = 'mission' and "permission_grant"."mission_id" is not null and "permission_grant"."run_id" is null)

ck_approval_subject.name: ck_approval_subject
ck_approval_subject.value: (("approval"."run_id" is not null) + ("approval"."mission_id" is not null) + ("approval"."manager_id" is not null)) = 1

ck_conversation_subject.name: ck_conversation_subject
ck_conversation_subject.value: ("conversation"."mission_id" is not null and "conversation"."manager_id" is null) or ("conversation"."mission_id" is null and "conversation"."manager_id" is not null)

ck_gate_binding_subject.name: ck_gate_binding_subject
ck_gate_binding_subject.value: ("gate_binding"."pipeline_edge_id" is not null and "gate_binding"."pipeline_node_id" is null and "gate_binding"."mission_id" is null) or ("gate_binding"."pipeline_edge_id" is null and "gate_binding"."pipeline_node_id" is not null and "gate_binding"."mission_id" is null) or ("gate_binding"."pipeline_edge_id" is null and "gate_binding"."pipeline_node_id" is null and "gate_binding"."mission_id" is not null)

ck_relay_subject.name: ck_relay_subject
ck_relay_subject.value: ("relay_item"."mission_id" is not null and "relay_item"."pipeline_run_id" is null) or ("relay_item"."mission_id" is null and "relay_item"."pipeline_run_id" is not null)

ck_manager_supervision_subject.name: ck_manager_supervision_subject
ck_manager_supervision_subject.value: ("manager_supervision"."mission_id" is not null and "manager_supervision"."pipeline_id" is null) or ("manager_supervision"."mission_id" is null and "manager_supervision"."pipeline_id" is not null)

ck_run_subject.name: ck_run_subject
ck_run_subject.value: ("run"."mission_id" is not null and "run"."manager_id" is null) or ("run"."mission_id" is null and "run"."manager_id" is not null)

ck_budget_scope_period.name: ck_budget_scope_period
ck_budget_scope_period.value: ("budget_window"."scope" = 'global' and "budget_window"."scope_id" is null and "budget_window"."period" = 'week') or ("budget_window"."scope" = 'mission' and "budget_window"."scope_id" is not null and "budget_window"."period" = 'mission_lifetime')

ck_concurrency_subject.name: ck_concurrency_subject
ck_concurrency_subject.value: ("concurrency_policy"."scope" = 'global' and "concurrency_policy"."scope_id" is null) or ("concurrency_policy"."scope" in ('project','provider') and "concurrency_policy"."scope_id" is not null)
